newsitem.title: GABON: Three cases of Ebola surface in Gabon.
newsitem.headline: Three cases of Ebola surface in Gabon.

text.p: Three people are in hospital in Gabon's capital Libreville after contracting the killer disease Ebola, medical sources said on Thursday.
The three arrived in the capital of the oil-producing Central African nation by train from Ogooue-Ivindo province where the virus surfaced earlier in the year, they added.
Doctors in hospitals in the city had been advised on precautions to protect themselves from the virus, they said.
Ebola, which can kill as many as eight out of 10 people infected by the virus, causes fever and uncontrollable bleeding.
Ebola killed seven people in Ogooue-Ivindo province in October after killing 13 people there in February.
It killed a nurse in South Africa last Sunday but health officials there said there was no sign of the disease spreading. The nurse caught the disease from a Gabonese doctor she was treating.
Ebola, which originated in the jungles of Central Africa and has been linked in Gabon and Ivory Coast to apes or monkeys, killed 245 people in and around the Zairean town of Kikwit in 1995.
